strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.reset.title: Reset Game
strings.settings.reset.subtitle: Start gameplay from the beginning
strings.settings.reset.confirm_message: This resets gameplay progress, rewards, currencies and tutorials. Purchases stay available.
strings.tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome
strings.tutorial.welcome.message.1: Tap the screen in battle to damage enemies.
strings.tutorial.welcome.message.2: Defeat enemies to earn coins, account XP and sometimes skill books.
strings.tutorial.welcome.message.3: New features unlock when your account level grows.
strings.tutorial.sprites.title: Sprites
strings.tutorial.sprites.message.1: Sprites are helpers you can collect.
strings.tutorial.sprites.message.2: When you summon helper sprites, they fight beside your selected character.
strings.tutorial.summon.title: Summon
strings.tutorial.summon.message.1: Summons use crystals and can unlock characters, skins, helper sprites and items.
strings.tutorial.summon.message.2: Duplicates increase stars, so old summons still make your team stronger.
strings.tutorial.skills.title: Skill Trees
strings.tutorial.skills.message.1: Skill books unlock upgrades in different skill trees.
strings.tutorial.skills.message.2: Some skills improve tap damage, others improve sprite damage, speed or drop chance.
strings.tutorial.trade.title: Trade
strings.tutorial.trade.message.1: Trade lets you exchange resources when you need a different currency.
strings.tutorial.trade.message.2: Use it carefully because some resources are rarer than others.
strings.tutorial.shop.title: Shop
strings.tutorial.shop.message.1: The shop contains optional crystal packs, battle passes and special packs.
strings.tutorial.shop.message.2: Coins, relics and skill books are still earned by playing.
strings.tutorial.battle.title: Battle
strings.tutorial.battle.message.1: Your character stands on the left and enemies stand on the right.
strings.tutorial.battle.message.2: Tap to attack. Active skills can be placed in the battle skill bar later.
strings.tutorial.event.title: Events
strings.tutorial.event.message.1: Events are limited battles with their own rewards and currencies.
strings.tutorial.event.message.2: Event chips can be traded for items, skins or resources while the event is active.
strings.tutorial.warehouse.title: Warehouse
strings.tutorial.warehouse.message.1: The warehouse stores your items, equipment and skins.
strings.tutorial.warehouse.message.2: Later you can equip bonuses here before going into battle.
strings.tutorial.settings.title: Settings
strings.tutorial.settings.message.1: Here you can change language, music and display options.
strings.tutorial.settings.message.2: Remote content still updates through the launch and update screens.
strings.tutorial.news.title: News
strings.tutorial.news.message.1: News shows current updates, events and changes.
strings.tutorial.news.message.2: Check it when new content or a limited event appears.
strings.tutorial.gift.title: Giftbox
strings.tutorial.gift.message.1: Rewards from gifts, events or compensation can appear here.
strings.tutorial.daily_login.title: Daily Login
strings.tutorial.daily_login.message.1: Daily login rewards help you progress even with short sessions.
strings.tutorial.daily_login.message.2: Come back each day to keep collecting the next reward.
